entities.name: María Jesús Carro Rossell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Jesús Carro Rossell is a Spanish mathematician specializing in mathematical analysis, including Fourier analysis, functional analysis, harmonic analysis, operator theory and the analysis of Lorentz spaces. She is a professor at the Complutense University of Madrid, in the Department of Mathematical Analysis and Applied Mathematics.
